## POST `/api/2.58/hosts/host-groups`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a membership to a host group. Creating a membership to a host group automatically connects the host to all volumes associated with the group. Multiple hosts can be belong to a host group, but a host can only belong to one host group. Hosts can be added to host groups at any time. The `group_names` and `member_names` parameters are required and must be set together, and only one host group can be specified at a time.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `context_names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the context specified. If specified, the context names must be an array of size 1, and the single element must be the name of an array in the same fleet or the name of the fleet itself. If not… |
| `group_names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the unique group name specified. Examples of groups include host groups, pods, protection groups, and volume groups. Enter multiple names in comma-separated format. For example,… |
| `member_names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the unique member name specified. Examples of members include volumes, hosts, host groups, and directories. Enter multiple names in comma-separated format. For example, `vol01,vol02`. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `MemberNoIdAllResponse`

## DELETE `/api/2.58/hosts/host-groups`

**Tier:** T3  

Deletes a membership from a host group. Deleting a membership from a host group automatically disconnects the host from all volumes associated with the group. Hosts can be deleted from host groups at any time. The `group_names` and `member_names` parameters are required and must be set together, and only one host group can be specified at a time.

## DELETE `/api/2.58/hosts/protection-groups`

**Tier:** T3  

Deletes a host member from a protection group. After the member has been removed, it is no longer protected by the group. Any protection group snapshots that were taken before the member was removed are not affected.
